preconditions.description: The total number of nodes n must be between 3 and 200,000.
The number of exit-nodes k must be at least 2 and at most n - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum possible distance between the two most distant exit-nodes followed by the list of wires connecting the nodes.
The number of wires must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(w.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(w.split()[1]) <= n for w in wires)
postconditions.description: Each wire must connect two valid nodes within the range from 1 to n.
